title: 23rd Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/23/3/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to foreign countries (Constitution Article 115(d) and Section 14 of Law No. 20/2021, the Foreign Service Act) are sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for members of the Tax Appeal Tribunal, under Section 56(a)(1) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), are sent to the relevant standing committee.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the bill submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to repeal Law No. 1/2013 (Freedom of Peaceful Assembly Act).
Budget Committee report on the proposed State Budget for 2026.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent ambassador and Tax Appeal Tribunal nominations to committee, continued debating the bill to repeal the Freedom of Peaceful Assembly Act, and took up the Budget Committee's report on the 2026 State Budget.
